# Ata Ul Haq — AI Engineer Portfolio

> The official portfolio of Ata Ul Haq, an AI engineer who builds production-ready computer vision, generative AI, multimodal, and full-stack AI products.

Ata Ul Haq works across the complete AI product path: preprocessing and model inference, resilient APIs, orchestration, databases, authentication, and polished interfaces. His strongest work includes multimodal moderation, creative AI tooling, medical computer vision, generative 3D, and full-stack product delivery.

Canonical website: https://ataulhaq.vercel.app

## Selected AI systems

- [Orvia Labs demo](https://youtu.be/-5e21EvldGg): Multi-model generative AI studio for image creation, editing, remixing, layering, and animation.
- [Aegis demo](https://youtu.be/9hSEKJ_aumE): Multimodal content moderation across text, image, audio, and video.
- [Orvia 3D Arts demo](https://youtu.be/f-yHO4Eawu4): Sketch-to-image-to-3D asset generation pipeline.
- [Dental AI source](https://github.com/Atasatti/Dental_AI): Oral diagnosis and implant-planning platform using RGB and X-ray computer vision.

## Shipped products

- [Orvia Studios](https://orvia-studios.vercel.app): Full-stack agency SaaS with client and admin workflows.
- [Oscillation Records](https://www.oscillationrecords.com): Production music platform with streaming, content management, accounts, and analytics.
